message: 誕生日

name: Arden
message: 「So this is Ryuusei Academy! Despite their interference, I've finally made it!」

name: Arden
message: 「Where is the Student Council! Where is the Student Council at!」

name: Pasta
message: 「W-What are you doing, nya!?」

name: Arden
message: 「Aaah. My beloved Pasta-chaaaaan!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Stay away from me, nyaaa!」

name: Arden
message: 「I get it. Those cold words are just your whip of love! Come on, lash me with more of 'em! My passion's burning hotter than ever!」

name: Arden
message: 「Anyway, where are those Student Council guys!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Saturdays are half-days, so they're not here anymore, nyan.」

name: Arden
message: 「Whaaaaaaaaaat!?」

name: Arden
message: 「Damn it, I'll have to try again! Pasta-chan, I swear I'll beat those guys for you! Just take a nap or something and wait for meee!」

name: Pasta
message: 「What a useless guy, nya...」

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, let's come together as one Student Council for this study session!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're really fired up.」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course! If we fail to save face, the Student Council's prestige will plummet, and stripped of authority, the academy will devolve into a lawless battlefield of survival of the fittest,」

name: Misa
message: 「the weak are oppressed, and even the strong grow arrogant from their own might, throwing their lives away in vain--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What kind of post-apocalyptic savior legend is that supposed to be?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's reassuring that nobody else is home at the President's house. We won't have to worry even if we make a little noise.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're gonna be making noise?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course. It is a study session, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「Are study sessions meant for making noise? I am not good at being rowdy, yet I must be.」

name: Azel
message: 「Waaah, waaah, waaah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Keep it down, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not need to make noise?」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um, since we all gathered here, let's study, okay?\s01 Azel-chan, put your camera away too」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm the official recorder」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san. Please leave studying about the Human World to me!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's memorize it together. Horizontal-Li-Be-Blue-Ship」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. So I don't need to memorize what you just said」

name: Misa
message: 「Exactly right」
And just like that, time flew by.

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... Look at the time already. Should we wrap it up for today--」

name: Misa
message: 「Not yet! I can still keep fighting!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Ahhh, 'ari, ori, haberi, imasokari' is marching through my head... Konjaku Monogatari...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do something about the Boston Tea Party... The tea, the tea is going into the sea...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like you're the only one who can still fight, Hiss」

name: Misa
message: 「You all lack a sense of urgency」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan. Let's call it a day around here. Otherwise it'll be time for 'that'」

name: Synn
message: 「'That'?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's nothing. Especially not for you, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Leaving me out!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haah... Still, I'm satisfied」

name: Ria
message: 「You made good progress studying? That's great」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With the soba noodles our treasurer made for us, I mean」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, that stuff was delicious」

name: Azel
message: 「It was good. I'm satisfied. Everyone had great expressions on their faces」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll admit it was delicious, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「What about the actual studying!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not asking is what they call a samurai's mercy.」

name: Synn
message: 「It looked like you were just taking pictures the whole time though, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「No problem. I memorized all the chemical formulas by heart.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it, being so formal all of a sudden?」

name: Ria
message: 「Is everyone ready?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Okay~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Bring it on!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's going on!?」
Suddenly, popping explosions burst out all around me.

name: Everyone
message: 「Happy Birthday~~!!」
Before I knew it, there was even a cake right in front of me!?

name: Synn
message: 「Um... uh... what is this?」

name: Ria
message: 「Like we said, happy birthday♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, come on! If you're a true Edoite, blow out the candles in one go!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So if you're not an Edoite, you blow them out one by one, then.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh. Is it bad to only blow out half of them?」

name: Misa
message: 「Just blow them out before overthinking it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, got 'em all in one breath. Not bad at all.」
Misa swiftly slices up the round cake.

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing... One-sixth--meaning a full sixty degrees--is all mine!」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious! Really delicious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, let's make tomorrow your birthday too! No, every day!」

name: Paqy
message: 「If he aged a year every day, Master Synn wouldn't even make it to April before kicking the bucket.」

name: Ria
message: 「Cake isn't the only thing.」
Ria-senpai handed me a small box wrapped with a cute ribbon.

name: Synn
message: 「Is this...... for me?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. Go ahead and open it.」

name: Synn
message: 「This is a ceramic whetstone!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. When I came by last time, I heard you were picking up random rocks to use as whetstones, and that'll ruin your blades easily.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, here is a birthday present from me as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's pretty heavy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please open it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-This is! An ultra-gorgeous chandelier!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're always broke, President-san, surely because you don't know what luxury is. So please gaze upon this every day and savor the feeling of extravagance.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks! Now I can live the gorgeous life too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That doesn't solve the root problem of him having no money, though.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Forget that, the ceiling's gonna cave in.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you. I'll keep it packed in the box and have gorgeous dreams!」

name: Azel
message: 「Was today your birthday?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Seems like it.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why am I the only one who didn't know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's not like we were leaving you out or anything! I mean, Azel, you didn't come to the academy on Friday or Saturday, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right. We're friends, so we would have told you if we'd seen you!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why didn't you say so at the library?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd forgotten about it myself until just a moment ago.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry. You're mad, aren't you...」

name: Azel
message: 「I was merely wondering why I didn't know.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no interest in anyone's birthday.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's Azel for you...」
That's a very Azel-like reaction, isn't it. Still, I'm a little disappointed. I wonder why?

name: Misa
message: 「Look, I didn't actually plan on actively celebrating your birthday at all, and even now I don't particularly feel like celebrating it, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「It would be unnatural if I were the only one in the Student Council who didn't pick out a present, so I'm giving you this. That's all it is.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph... Hurry up and open it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. This is a CD player!」

name: Misa
message: 「You don't own one anyway, do you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「He doesn't even have the money to buy albums in the first place.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks! I don't know when, but I'll definitely put this to good use!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm glad you like it... I'll lend you an album next time.」

name: Azel
message: 「So it is unnecessary right now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right now, yeah. But not forever.」

name: Misa
message: 「I told you I'll lend you something!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fuhaha. Now it's time for me, the childhood friend who knows everything about Synn, to step in! I know exactly what Synn needs right now!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As expected of a relationship so old and tangled it's completely fermented」

name: Ria
message: 「That phrasing is a bit much」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ta-da! Here you go」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, what's this! A brand-new telescoping tree pruner! Now this is a fine piece of gear!」

name: Azel
message: 「Mmph...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've been nursing that broken old one along, right? Plus, this is the latest model, so it can reach even higher than before」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You were just complaining the other day about how the cedar in the corner of the yard got too big and was a pain to trim」

name: Misa
message: 「What terrifyingly thorough recon!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Indeed. Truly my childhood friend who knows everything about me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Praise me! Rejoice!」

name: Synn
message: 「I rejoice!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now, commemorative photo! Azel, take a picture, take a picture!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, don't wrap your arms around my neck!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, the classic couple's two-shot」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you talking about, geez! It's a birthday tree-pruner commemorative shot!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Unnatural photos are rejected」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehh. That's harsh」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh? Azel-chan, you look pale」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh... oh, you're right! Are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「No problem. I'm heading home」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehh, we're wrapping up already!? What about the pillow fight!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This girl. I was wondering why her bag was bulging so weirdly, and she actually brought her own personal pillow」

name: Misa
message: 「Exams are right around the corner, and you're slacking off!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Please walk Azel-chan home」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Walking alone together at night is even more dangerous! Synn will turn into a wolf in sheep's clothing!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun doesn't have the guts for that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer, please don't be a spoilsport. Let's leave this to the two young lovebirds」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not a matchmaking date! I'm coming along too!」

name: Azel
message: 「Do whatever you want」

name: Azel
message: 「I tried taking the past exam you got for me」

name: Synn
message: 「How did it go?」

name: Azel
message: 「Using the method you taught me, I managed to avoid a failing grade」

name: Synn
message: 「Then you'll probably be fine on the real thing too, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「The questions will be different. So it's uncertain」

name: Synn
message: 「True」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Method?」

name: Synn
message: 「Stuff like how to find the right answer on multiple-choice questions and things like that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「......So Synn taught you」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「......Even though you never used to listen to what anyone said」

name: Azel
message: 「Didn't he teach you too?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not it. Synn teaches everyone carefully, after all. He doesn't give anyone special treatment」

name: Azel
message: 「You never cut corners, do you. Just like you」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not about cutting corners or anything. Something like this is no big deal」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka? Is something wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's nothing! See ya, Synn!」

name: Azel
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「It just seemed like she wanted to say something.」

name: Azel
message: 「If it is important, she will say it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess. Yeah, you're right.」
We walked down the road toward the academy in silence.
It wasn't an awkward silence, though--it felt comfortable.

name: Azel
message: 「How pretty.」

name: Azel
message: 「For some reason, it looks beautiful.」
I followed Azel's gaze.
Across the night sky, shooting stars streaked past, one after another.
They kept falling in an endless stream.

name: Azel
message: 「It is merely a physical phenomenon, yet how strange.」
A familiar sight to me. Yet still a beautiful one.

name: Azel
message: 「Did you know? There is a photo book in the library filled entirely with pictures of Ryuusei Town's night sky.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Someone actually did that?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes, they did.」
Azel's slender arm reached toward the heavens, fingers opening as if to catch a shooting star.

name: Azel
message: 「At first, I couldn't understand what moved the photographer to shoot the night sky. Still, the photo book was gorgeous. I assumed it was simply the photographer's skill.」

name: Azel
message: 「Now, however, I understand. This town's night sky truly is beautiful.」
They streak past. Streak past. Streak past.

name: Azel
message: 「At some point, I began to find it pretty. Tonight, it is especially so.」
With that murmur, Azel looked at me.

name: Azel
message: 「Could it be because I am with you?」
Words spun out without a trace of pretension.
A gaze directed straight at me.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Who knows?」

name: Azel
message: 「The sky is just the sky, I suppose. There is no reason it would have anything to do with us.」
After that, we fell silent.
In the comfortable silence, I watched the night sky until we reached the dorm.
